title: Vendor Intake Checklist Form
subtitle: A practical execution checklist for vendor intake that connects identity, observations and evidence, decision authority, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original retail-operations execution checklist for vendor intake covering vendor onboarding and access, evidence references, authorization, escalation, operating limits, disposition, and handoff without copying a third-party form.
use_case: Use when a vendor coordinator opens one vendor intake record to execute required steps, record conditions, route exceptions, make a release decision, and hand off open work; closure requires a documented outcome, evidence route, responsible owner, and recipient acknowledgment.

sections.title: Vendor checklist identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this checklist to one location, operating period, accountable owner, and review route.

blocks.label: Vendor event scope, trigger, affected area, and prior handoff

fields.label: Vendor Intake scope and routing context

sections.title: Vendor readiness and execution sequence
sections.guidance: Mark each independently verified step; explain any item that cannot be completed as planned.

blocks.label: Vendor steps
items: Vendor legal or trading name and approved contact linked
Requested goods, services, locations, and term defined
Business sponsor and purchasing route identified
Required policy documents referenced by status only
Site access, delivery, system, and data needs classified
Conflicts, subcontractors, and restricted scope disclosed
Commercial and payment setup routed to approved systems
Operational readiness owners completed their reviews
Approval, conditional approval, hold, or rejection recorded
Renewal, performance, and offboarding owner assigned

blocks.label: Operating boundary
blocks.guidance: Use references and status fields rather than copying tax identifiers, bank details, identity documents, credentials, or confidential contracts into this general form. A listed document is not a legal or professional validation. Follow applicable purchasing, access, privacy, security, and retention policy and route specialist judgments to the authorized reviewer.

sections.title: Vendor conditions and supporting evidence
sections.guidance: Record what was actually observed; a checked condition is a routing signal, not a conclusion.

blocks.label: Condition indicators reviewed
items: Vendor identity or authorized contact mismatch
Scope, site, product, or subcontractor unclear
Required document expired, missing, or not applicable
Data, system, key, badge, or after-hours access requested
Commercial setup differs from approved purchase route
Conflict or restricted-category review needed
Operational owner has not accepted the handoff
Start date precedes completed approvals

blocks.label: Observation, location, time, people affected, source, and evidence reference

fields.label: Vendor Intake observation and evidence detail

sections.title: Vendor exceptions, escalation, and release decision
sections.guidance: Give each exception an immediate action, owner, due point, escalation route, and disposition.

blocks.label: Exception and stop indicators
items: Vendor identity or ownership review unresolved
Required record or policy acknowledgment missing
Sensitive access requires specialist approval
Emergency or temporary vendor route requested
Commercial terms or payment setup disputed
Start, renewal, suspension, or rejection decision pending

sections.title: Vendor outcome, closeout, and handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and acceptance visible.

blocks.label: Vendor closeout controls
items: Approved vendor ID and scope recorded
Site, system, and data access owners notified
Commercial setup reference linked in restricted system
Conditions and expiration dates have owners
Start or hold decision communicated to sponsor
Renewal and offboarding responsibility assigned

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
Unresolved work, customer or staff impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Vendor Intake residual work and handoff

blocks.label: Checklist closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not a legal, safety, or professional certification.
